name: smwpatches-seperate-luigi-mario-counters
title: Seperate Luigi/Mario Counters
description:
This patch will allow Mario and Luigi to have separate coin/lives/score counters on the status bar. Give credit! I had to re-code most of the status bar to get this to work!

This fixed score counter is waaaay more accurate than the last one. Also note that the zeros will always show on the score, just because this patch was basically made for my hack, and that how I want it in my hack, but you can fix that yourself if you don't want it like that.
